context:
Goal: a plain "use Opus" message grants Opus only to the work your nearby messages name (your 226 b).
Problem (money): 226 said the scope comes from your messages before and after the ask. When you send the ask, no later message exists yet. Reading later messages means one model call on each of your messages while the grant lives, even ones that never say "opus".
Based on (read): #1244 (batch 10, Nov 5 06:36 CST) put option a on main: hooks/local_time.py reads your earlier messages with the ask.
Departs from: main (earlier messages only) — b also lets a later message narrow a live grant.
home: claude-settings decision owner-override; lane opus-plain-ask-scope record

options.how: No change: main does this since #1244.

options.lose: A later message cannot narrow a live grant.

short: Opus ask: read later messages too?
title: Should a plain Opus ask also read your messages after the ask?
why: It keeps the cost to one call per ask, and the part both options need is already being built.
